lineage.description: IPC classification data collected by FEWS NET enumerators across Guatemala on a regular monthly schedule (January, April, July, October 2014). Geographic polygons with IPC phase classifications and scenario assessments were compiled into GeoJSON and KML formats to represent spatial distribution of acute food insecurity conditions.
